conditions: The form is the ordinary record expression with field initializers in §6.3.6. The labels resolve to a single record type whose fields are accessible.
limitations: The captured F# 4.1 working document records May 2018 updates, omits some F# 4.1 RFCs, and warns of implementation discrepancies. Other RFCs, releases, and compiler behavior require separate evidence.

The elaboration supplies no guarantee of a deep copy, physical allocation, representation or evaluation of shared referenced objects. Anonymous records and other record forms have separate applicability.

triggers: A changed publisher representation, applicable omitted RFC, source correction or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: The F# 4.1 working specification elaborates a copy-and-update record expression by binding the original expression to a fresh variable. The resulting record uses the listed field initializers and takes the value of each unlisted field from that variable.
